verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Mistral publishes an llms.txt at docs.mistral.ai (HTTP 200), with a structured index of markdown doc links an agent can follow. However, the markdown variant of the Document AI overview page returned 404, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: confirmed llms.txt coverage of Document AI pages, working per-page markdown docs for document processing, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
